body:
Documented the standing default for a big, unscoped priority/cruise-queue ask: investigate, write a real phased NORTHSTAR, register as golden doc, return the real sub-tasks to BACKLOG.md rather than marking the whole card done once a plan exists. Doesn't change how a genuine 'plan this' card closes.

⚓ ☃
title: New Principle 19: scope big asks, don't swallow them whole (kanban GOLDENOPS-001)
